environment.description: Celery workers deployed on ECS Fargate tasks within a private subnet (subnet-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The subnet route table (rtb-9f8e7d6c5b4a3210) contains only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no NAT instance, no VPC endpoint for S3/SES, and no transit gateway attachment. The only reachable endpoint is the Redis broker via VPC-internal DNS (redis.internal.local on port 6379). ECS task networking uses awsvpc mode with ENI attached to the private subnet. Security group sg-0fedcba987654321 allows outbound only to 10.0.0.0/16:6379 (Redis) and denies all other egress including DNS to public resolvers. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to non-10.0.0.0/16 destinations from the worker subnet over 90-day retention period.

config.security_group: sg-0fedcba987654321: egress ALLOW tcp 10.0.0.0/16:6379, egress DENY 0.0.0.0/0:*
config.ecs_task_networking: awsvpc mode, ENI in private subnet
config.redis_broker: redis.internal.local:6379, VPC-internal only, Redis AUTH enabled
config.vpc_flow_logs: enabled, 90-day retention, zero non-local egress observed
